speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) whether the Ministry will consider putting a minimum number of years before a development project can qualify for an En bloc collective sale; (b) how many developments that are less than 30 years old have undergone En bloc sales in the past three years; and (c) whether the Ministry considers this to be a waste of resources.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Such redevelopment allows rejuvenation and land use optimisation in residential developments.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The collective sales framework imposes higher consent thresholds for newer developments.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: That is the framework that I have put in place in the Land Titles (Strata) Act.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: The consent thresholds are clearly specified but there are also safeguards in place.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: But there are safeguards and controls in place which I have just described.
